```{r}
# Create heat map of which pairs were selected from the dose response
test_df = split_dabs[[1]]
test_pair_names = colnames(test_df %>% select(-c("Conc.", "Replicates", "target_vector")))
all_pair_names = colnames(screen_df %>% select(-c("Conc.", "Replicates", "target_vector")))

# Extract dAb
dAb_names = unique(sub("_.*","",test_pair_names))
all_dab_names = unique(sub("_.*", "", all_pair_names))

# Extract cAb list
cAb_names = unique(sub("[^_]*","",test_pair_names)) %>% substring(first = 2)
all_cab_names = unique(sub("[^_]*", "", all_pair_names)) %>% substring(first = 2)

# Create binary matrix of pairs
test_bool = ifelse(all_cab_names %in% cAb_names, 1, 0)

bool_pair_matrix = function(cab_list, dab_list, df_list){

  bool_matrix = data.frame("dAb" = dab_list)
  cab_bool_mat = data.frame(matrix(nrow = 1, ncol = length(cab_list)))
  colnames(cab_bool_mat) = cab_list

  row_ind = 1
  for (df in df_list){
    df_pairs = colnames(df %>% select(-c("Conc.", "Replicates", "target_vector")))
    cab_names = unique(sub("[^_]*","",df_pairs)) %>% substring(first = 2)
    bool_arr = ifelse(cab_list %in% cab_names, 1, 0)
    cab_bool_mat[row_ind,] = bool_arr
    row_ind = row_ind + 1
  }
  bool_matrix = cbind(bool_matrix, cab_bool_mat)
  bool_matrix = melt(bool_matrix)
  return(bool_matrix)
}

pair_bool_matrix = bool_pair_matrix(all_cab_names, all_dab_names, split_dabs)

# Create heatmap
ab_pair_heatmap <- ggplot(pair_bool_matrix, aes(dAb, variable)) +                           # Create heatmap with ggplot2
  geom_tile(aes(fill = value)) +
  labs(title = "Antibody pair heatmap",
       x = "Detection Antibody",
       y = "Capture Antibody")+
  scale_fill_gradient(low = 'pink', high = 'darkred')
ab_pair_heatmap
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
heat_map_list = list()
```

```{r}
# Box plots  
box_plot_func = function(dataframe, target, cols_to_exclude, title){
  # The below check will fail if only a subset of the columns are in cols_to_exclude
  if(any(cols_to_exclude) %in% colnames(dataframe)){
    dataframe = dataframe %>% dplyr::select(-cols_to_exclude)
  }
  
  box_list = list()
  plot_index = 1
  
  for (pair in colnames(dataframe %>% select_if(is.numeric))){
    p = dataframe %>% ggplot(aes_string(x=target, y=pair)) +
      geom_boxplot()
    box_list[[plot_index]] = p
    plot_index = plot_index + 1
  }
  plot_image = arrangeGrob(grobs = box_list, top = title)
  return(plot_image)
}
cols_to_exclude = c("Conc.", "Replicates")
box_plot_base = box_plot_func(test_df, "target_vector", cols_to_exclude, "Boxplots by variant for each antibody pair (All samples)")
box_plots_low_thresh = box_plot_func(low_thresh_df, "target_vector", cols_to_exclude, "Boxplots by variant for each antibody pair (Concentration > 0.01 ng/ml)")
box_plots_mid_thresh = box_plot_func(mid_thresh_df, "target_vector", cols_to_exclude, "Boxplots by variant for each antibody pair (Concentration > 0.8 ng/ml)")
box_plots_strict_thresh = box_plot_func(strict_thresh_df, "target_vector", cols_to_exclude, "Boxplots by variant for each antibody pair (Concentration > 0.1 ng/ml)")

ggsave(file = "boxplot_no_threshold.png", box_plot_base, dpi = 320, width = 10)
ggsave(file = "boxplot_low_threshold.png", box_plots_low_thresh, dpi = 320, width = 10)

ggsave(file = "boxplot_strict_threshold.png", box_plots_strict_thresh, dpi = 320, width = 10)
```

```{r}
# Ridges plot by variant

    pivot_longer(cols = -sorter_col, names_to = 'val') %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = value, y = sorter_col, fill = stat(quantile))) +
    stat_density_ridges(quantile_lines=T,
                        calc_ecdf = T,
                        geom = 'density_ridges_gradient',
                        quantiles = c(0.05, 0.95)) +  # geom_density_ridges(alpha=0.9) +
    scale_fill_manual(name='Prob.', values = c('seagreen1', 'seagreen3', 'seagreen'),
                      labels = c("(0, 5%]", "(5%, 95%]", '(95%, 1]'))+
    facet_wrap(~val, scales = 'free_x')  +
    labs(
      title = 'Trends in each parameter',
      x = 'Scaled log fluorescence',
      y = 'Frequency'
    )
```

```{r}
# Correlation matrices
corrplot_list = list()
corrplot_ind = 1
corrplot_func = function(df_list, threshold = 0){
  for(df in df_list){
    numeric_df = df %>% select_if(is.numeric) %>% filter(Conc. > threshold) %>% select(-Conc.) 
    dab = unique(sub("_.*", "", numeric_df))
    cor_mat = cor(numeric_df)
    plot = corrplot(cor_mat, method = 'number', order = 'AOE')
    corrplot_list[[corrplot_ind]] = plot
    corrplot_ind = corrplot_ind + 1
  }
  plot_grid = arrangeGrob(corrplot_list)
  return(plot_grid)
}
```
